title: Workflows component diagram
description: The three workflows GitHub runs and the three scripts beside them: what each calls, and what lies outside the folder. Nothing here deploys since deploy.yml was removed on 2026-11-23; last-deployed.sh, migration-gate.sh's deploy mode and game.yml's deploy input are left over from it.

components.name: Workflows
components.responsibility: Tests every pull request and checks its database changes. Deploys nothing: each game is deployed by hand with npm run deploy in its folder.

components.name: CI (ci.yml)
components.responsibility: On every pull request: validates the .dev files and tests and builds each game the pull request changes.

components.name: Database migration (migrations.yml)
components.responsibility: The required pull request check: fails until a database change is acknowledged in the description.

components.name: Game (game.yml)
components.responsibility: One game's install, tests, build and the check that no .dev folder is in the build. Its wrangler deploy step runs only when called with deploy true, which nothing does since deploy.yml was removed.

components.name: Changed games (changed-games.sh)
components.responsibility: Lists the games with a package.json that changed since a commit, leaving .dev files out.

components.name: Last deployed (last-deployed.sh)
components.responsibility: Finds the commit the last successful Deploy run deployed. Unused since deploy.yml was removed: nothing calls it.

components.name: Migration gate (migration-gate.sh)
components.responsibility: Finds database files changed since a commit and fails unless each change is acknowledged. Only its pr mode runs (migrations.yml); its deploy mode is unused since deploy.yml was removed.

components.name: Games
components.responsibility: The games the workflows test and build; each is deployed by hand from its own folder with npm run deploy.

components.name: Validators (Meta/Agents)
components.responsibility: validate_diagrams.py and validate_knowledge.py, copied from human-assisted-software-development.

components.name: GitHub
components.responsibility: Runs the workflows on its events, and answers the gh calls for pull request descriptions (and, from the unused last-deployed.sh, for Deploy runs).

components.name: Cloudflare
components.responsibility: Receives each game's Worker and assets from wrangler deploy, which is run by hand from the game's folder.
